description: Rejects asserting that having matrix entries in {+/-1, +/-i} proves membership in the Fourier family.
negative_fixture: Every matrix whose entries are fourth roots of unity is unitarily equivalent to the Fourier matrix F_6.
positive_fixture: Fourier membership requires evaluating the phase-independent conjugate cross-ratio CR(a,b,c,d) = 1, which distinguishes F_6 from Butson Hadamard matrices.
